(Linear) Fusion Rifles and Heat Weapons are granted +? Handling and +? Reload Speed.

perks.name: Shock and Clear
perks.description: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Jolt Kill or a Jolted Enemy Kill:
Creates an Ionic Trace.

archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians who take a weapon-centric approach.

Primary Stat: Weapons
Secondary Stat: Grenade

item.name: +Weapons / -Health
item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

item.name: Harmonic Scavenger
item.description: Arc weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.
